title: Make Generated Rust Lockfile Presence Explicit in Clean-Clone Provenance
body:
After preserving a generated ignored root Cargo.lock outside the repository to satisfy root-clutter policy, a focused test exposed that source_snapshot unconditionally reads it. A clean clone has no such tracked file and the CLI would fail before simulation.

## Acceptance Criteria

Treat only the generated lockfile as optional, recording its presence or absence explicitly. Keep all tracked scientific source files and native binary mandatory and hash-verified. Retain the original frozen experiment lockfile inside the existing source snapshot archive. Add a failing clean-clone-style test without Cargo.lock, then verify provenance, matrix, CLI and root-clutter contracts.

## Validation

Post-format focused lane produced FileNotFoundError in test_matrix after ignored build-artifact cleanup. Red–green absence/presence regression required; no saved flight rows or archived source bytes may change.

## Handoff

Branch `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`; keep open until merged implementing PR. This correction makes clean checkout execution robust without weakening required scientific source receipts.
